available_elderly_infrastructure.description: The main entrance and exit pathways are wide and flat, making last-mile vehicle drop-offs highly accessible.
The sprawling outer complex features flat paths and a lush lawn area with minimal steep steps.
Benches and seating structures are positioned around the outer garden lawns for elderly pilgrims to sit and rest.
Clean drinking water stations are maintained near the entrance.

crucial_accessibility_limitations.description: While the entrance is wheelchair accessible, actual wheelchair friendly passage is limited to the outer courtyard areas. The inner sanctum chambers (Trikutalayam) are elevated on a raised stone platform.

To see the main deities, elderly visitors must climb a small set of steps, ancient stone stairs. There are no ramps or mechanical lifts leading onto the main platform or into the narrow temple corridors.
Shoes must be left at the entrance counter. The stone flooring can become hot and uncomfortable for seniors to walk on during peak afternoon hours
